clips.title: The story
paras: Bishop Farthing sends you north from Stormwind to seek a way past Morbent Fel's wards. The trail leads across Khaz Modan to the wreckage of Kul Tiras's Third Fleet off the Wetlands.

Morbent Fel's wards turn aside ordinary steel at his retreat on the Forlorn Rowe. Bishop Farthing sends you to seek a weapon bound to the Holy Light. Its key is Lightforge Iron, a rare consecrated metal whose strikes carry holy truth and pierce sorcerous protections.

Duskwood has no supply of Lightforge Iron ready to hand. Bishop Farthing recalls that Kul Tiras's Third Fleet sank years ago along the dangerous Wetlands coast, north of Ironforge. One of its galleons carried a shipment of the precious ore. You travel to Menethil Harbor to meet Glorin Steelbrow, a dwarven contact who knows the marshes and their wrecks.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Years ago, the Third Fleet of Kul'Tiras sunk along the coasts of The Wetlands, an expanse of marsh north of the Dwarven kingdom of Ironforge. Aboard one ship was a load of Lightforge Iron.
This metal is precious to us, for items crafted from it strike with holy truth. If you are to face Morbent Fel, then you will need such a weapon.
Go to Menethil Harbor and speak with my dwarven colleague Glorin Steelbrow. If that lost metal can be found, he'll know where to look.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Lightforge Iron is a precious metal, but it sounds like your quest is a dire one. You've come a long way, Friend. With luck, you might just find what you seek!
And if you do get the iron, I know who can fashion it into a weapon against this Necromancer you speak of in Duskwood.
